digest.component_or_area: MCP gate resolvers and config parsing
propositions: config.mcp_readonly() and config.mcp_gate() collapse ConfigError into a bool default instead of raising, violating operator ruling 39f8-ae7c that unreadable config must error
MCP adapter cannot surface config-read faults because resolvers swallow ConfigError, preventing MCP clients from receiving structured error envelopes
config.mcp_gate(fail) parameter exists only to provide a fallback for malformed-config cases and should be removed once resolvers raise instead
Unreadable config must propagate as typed ConfigError through all call paths (mcp_server resolvers, runner_support._readonly_gate, error envelope) without intermediate swallowing
Error envelope and error classification must support config_unreadable code to surface malformed rebar.toml/pyproject.toml faults in MCP structured responses
